   202→async function switchChartType(type: 'candle' | 'profile') {
   203→  if (type === chartType.value) return
   204→  // fade out
   205→  contentVisible.value = false
   206→  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150))
   207→  // switch tab
   208→  chartType.value = type
   209→  if (type === 'profile' && profileData.value.length === 0) {
   210→    loadProfile()
   211→  }
   212→  if (type === 'candle') {
   213→    await nextTick()
   214→    if (chartContainer.value) {
   215→      chart?.resize(chartContainer.value.clientWidth, chartHeight())
   216→    }
   217→    chart?.timeScale().fitContent()
   218→  }
   219→  // fade in
   220→  await nextTick()
   221→  contentVisible.value = true
   222→}
   223→
   224→watch(period, loadChart)
   225→watch(profilePeriod, () => {
   226→  if (chartType.value === 'profile') loadProfile()
   227→})
   228→
   229→onMounted(async () => {
   230→  if (!chartContainer.value) return

   233→  chart = createChart(chartContainer.value, {

   255→

   268→  chart.priceScale('volume').applyOptions({ scaleMargins: { top: 0.8, bottom: 0 } })

   270→  const handleResize = () => {

   273→    }

   275→  window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)
   276→  onUnmounted(() => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize))
   277→
   278→  await loadChart()
   279→})
   280→
   281→onUnmounted(() => {

   283→})

讓我先驗算一下，買入價格500、賣出價格600、10股：

- 買入手續費 = max(20, round(500 × 10 × 0.1425%)) = max(20, 7) = **20**
- 賣出手續費 = max(20, round(600 × 10 × 0.1425%)) = max(20, 9) = **20**
- 交易稅 = round(600 × 10 × 0.3%) = **18**
- 買入成本 = 5000 + 20 = **5020**
- 損益 = 6000 - 20 - 18 - 5020 = **942** ✓

計算公式是對的！括號裡的 `(7)` 和 `(9)` 是實際算出來的費用，因為低於最低手續費20元所以取20。

   132→import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted } from 'vue'

   138→const router = useRouter()

   140→const alerts = ref<any[]>([])
   141→const loading = ref(false)

   149→const filteredAlerts = computed(() => {
   150→  const q = searchQuery.value.trim().toLowerCase()
   151→  if (!q) return alerts.value
   152→  return alerts.value.filter(
   153→    a => a.ticker.toLowerCase().includes(q) || a.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (a.user_email && a.user_email.toLowerCase().includes(q))
   154→  )

   156→
   157→const totalPages = computed(() => Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredAlerts.value.length / pageSize.value)))
   158→const pagedAlerts = computed(() => {

   160→  return filteredAlerts.value.slice(start, start + pageSize.value)
   161→})
   162→
   163→watch(searchQuery, () => { currentPage.value = 1 })
   164→watch(pageSize, () => { currentPage.value = 1 })
   165→
   166→function jumpToPage() {

   168→  if (n >= 1 && n <= totalPages.value) currentPage.value = n

   170→}
   171→
   172→async function loadAlerts() {
   173→  loading.value = true
   174→  const start = Date.now()
   175→  try {
   176→    const res = await client.get('/alerts')
   177→    alerts.value = res.data
   178→  } finally {
   179→    const elapsed = Date.now() - start
   180→    if (400 - elapsed > 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400 - elapsed))
   181→    loading.value = false
   182→  }
   183→}
   184→
   185→function startEdit(alert: any) {
   186→  editingAlert.value = alert
   187→  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
   188→}
   189→
   190→function onAlertSaved() {
   191→  editingAlert.value = null
   192→  loadAlerts()
   193→}
   194→
   195→async function doDelete() {

   197→  await client.delete(`/alerts/${deleteTarget.value.id}`)
   198→  deleteTarget.value = null
   199→  await loadAlerts()
   200→}

   202→function logout() {

   205→}

   207→onMounted(loadAlerts)

              <input v-model.number="sellPrice" type="number" min="0.01" class="num-field" @change="clampSell" />

                <button :class="{ active: sharesUnit === '張' }" @click="sharesUnit = '張'">張</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

            實際股數：{{ actualShares.toLocaleString() }} 股
          </div>

            <span>賣出價格 <span class="sum-val">{{ formatPrice(sellPrice) }}元</span></span>
            <span>損益兩平價格 <span class="sum-val breakeven">{{ formatPrice(breakevenPrice) }}元</span></span>
          </div>

                    <span :class="{ 'profit-box': row.isTarget }">{{ row.profit.toLocaleString() }}</span>
                  </td>

                    {{ row.buyFee }}
                    <span class="actual-fee">({{ row.buyFeeActual }})</span>
                  </td>
                  <td class="fee-cell">
                    {{ row.sellFee }}
                    <span class="actual-fee">({{ row.sellFeeActual }})</span>
                  </td>
                  <td>{{ row.tax }}</td>
                  <td>{{ row.totalCost.toLocaleString() }}</td>

</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'

const stockType = ref<'stock' | 'etf'>('stock')
const buyPrice = ref(500)
const sellPrice = ref(600)
const sharesInput = ref(10)
const sharesUnit = ref<'股' | '張'>('股')

const actualShares = computed(() =>
  sharesUnit.value === '張' ? sharesInput.value * 1000 : sharesInput.value,
)

const taxRate = computed(() => (stockType.value === 'etf' ? 0.001 : 0.003))

function getTickSize(price: number): number {
  if (price < 10) return 0.01
  if (price < 50) return 0.05
  if (price < 100) return 0.1
  if (price < 500) return 0.5
  if (price < 1000) return 1
  return 5
}

function roundToTick(price: number, tick: number): number {
  return Math.round(price / tick) * tick
}

function formatPrice(p: number): string {
  const tick = getTickSize(p)
  if (tick < 0.1) return p.toFixed(2)
  if (tick < 1) return p.toFixed(1)
  return p.toFixed(0)
}

function calcFeeInfo(price: number, shares: number) {
  const actual = Math.round(price * shares * 0.001425)
  return { fee: Math.max(20, actual), actual }
}

const buyFeeInfo = computed(() => calcFeeInfo(buyPrice.value, actualShares.value))

const buyCost = computed(() => buyPrice.value * actualShares.value + buyFeeInfo.value.fee)

function calcRow(sp: number) {
  const shares = actualShares.value
  const { fee: sellFee, actual: sellFeeActual } = calcFeeInfo(sp, shares)
  const tax = Math.round(sp * shares * taxRate.value)
  const profit = Math.round(sp * shares - sellFee - tax - buyCost.value)
  const totalCost = Math.round(buyCost.value + sellFee + tax)
  const returnRate = totalCost > 0 ? (profit / totalCost * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : '—'
  return {
    sellPrice: sp,
    profit,
    returnRate,
    buyFee: buyFeeInfo.value.fee,
    buyFeeActual: buyFeeInfo.value.actual,
    sellFee,
    sellFeeActual,
    tax,
    totalCost,
    isTarget: Math.abs(sp - sellPrice.value) < 0.0001,
  }
}

const tableRows = computed(() => {
  const sp = sellPrice.value
  const tick = getTickSize(sp)
  const rows = []
  for (let i = -10; i <= 10; i++) {
    const p = Math.round((sp + i * tick) / tick) * tick
    if (p > 0) rows.push(calcRow(p))
  }
  return rows
})

const breakevenPrice = computed(() => {
  const buy = buyPrice.value
  const tick = getTickSize(buy)
  for (let i = 0; i <= 5000; i++) {
    const p = roundToTick(buy + i * tick, tick)
    const { fee: sf } = calcFeeInfo(p, actualShares.value)
    const tax = Math.round(p * actualShares.value * taxRate.value)
    const profit = p * actualShares.value - sf - tax - buyCost.value
    if (profit >= 0) return p
  }
  return buy
})

function adjustPrice(field: 'buy' | 'sell', dir: number) {
  const cur = field === 'buy' ? buyPrice.value : sellPrice.value
  const tick = getTickSize(cur)
  const next = Math.max(tick, roundToTick(cur + dir * tick, tick))
  if (field === 'buy') buyPrice.value = next
  else sellPrice.value = next
}

function adjustShares(dir: number) {
  sharesInput.value = Math.max(1, sharesInput.value + dir)
}

function clampBuy() {
  if (!buyPrice.value || buyPrice.value <= 0) buyPrice.value = 0.01
}

function clampSell() {
  if (!sellPrice.value || sellPrice.value <= 0) sellPrice.value = 0.01
}
</script>

完成了！實作內容：

**新增 `/calculator` 頁面**
- 左側：交易類別（股票/ETF）、買入價格、賣出價格、交易數量（支援股/張切換）
- 右側：試算結果表格，顯示賣出價格 ±10 tick 的範圍，highlight 你輸入的那行
- 欄位：賣出價格、損益金額、報酬率、買入手續費（實際值）、賣出手續費（實際值）、證券交易稅、固投資成本
- 標題列顯示買入價格、賣出價格、損益兩平價格

**計算公式**
- 手續費 = max(20, round(價格 × 股數 × 0.1425%))
- 交易稅 = round(賣出價 × 股數 × 0.3%) — ETF 用 0.1%
- tick size 依台股規則自動判斷（< 10 → 0.01，10-50 → 0.05，等）

**導覽**
- 警報列表頁 header 加了「股市計算機」按鈕

    44→static_dir = Path(__file__).parent / "static"
    45→if static_dir.exists():
    46→    # Serve actual static assets (js/css/images) directly
    47→    app.mount("/assets", StaticFiles(directory=str(static_dir / "assets")), name="assets")
    48→
    49→    # SPA catch-all: serve index.html for any non-API route (supports Vue Router history mode)
    50→    @app.get("/{full_path:path}")
    51→    async def serve_spa(full_path: str):
    52→        file = static_dir / full_path
    53→        if file.exists() and file.is_file():
    54→            return FileResponse(str(file))
    55→        return FileResponse(str(static_dir / "index.html"))

     1→import logging
     2→from typing import Optional
     3→
     4→import twstock
     5→
     6→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
     7→
     8→# twstock.codes: dict of code -> StockCodeInfo
     9→# StockCodeInfo has: name, group, market ("上市"/"上櫃")
    10→_STOCK_MAP: dict[str, dict] = {}
    11→
    12→
    13→def _build_stock_map() -> None:
    14→    for code, info in twstock.codes.items():
    15→        suffix = ".TW" if getattr(info, "market", "") == "上市" else ".TWO"
    16→        _STOCK_MAP[code] = {
    17→            "ticker": f"{code}{suffix}",
    18→            "code": code,
    19→            "name": info.name,
    20→        }
    21→
    22→
    23→def ensure_loaded() -> None:
    24→    if not _STOCK_MAP:
    25→        try:
    26→            _build_stock_map()
    27→        except Exception as e:
    28→            logger.error(f"Failed to build stock map: {e}")
    29→
    30→
    31→def search_stocks(keyword: str, limit: int = 10) -> list[dict]:
    32→    ensure_loaded()
    33→    keyword = keyword.strip()
    34→    results = []
    35→    for code, info in _STOCK_MAP.items():
    36→        if keyword in code or keyword in info["name"]:
    37→            results.append(info)
    38→        if len(results) >= limit:
    39→            break
    40→    return results
    41→
    42→
    43→def get_ticker(code: str) -> Optional[str]:
    44→    ensure_loaded()
    45→    entry = _STOCK_MAP.get(code)
    46→    return entry["ticker"] if entry else None
    47→
    48→
    49→def get_name(code: str) -> Optional[str]:
    50→    ensure_loaded()
    51→    entry = _STOCK_MAP.get(code)
    52→    return entry["name"] if entry else None
    53→

     1→import logging
     2→import math
     3→from typing import Literal

     6→from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
     7→
     8→from auth import get_current_user
     9→from stock_data import search_stocks
    10→
    11→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    12→
    13→router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/stocks", tags=["stocks"])
    14→
    15→
    16→def _tick_size(price: float) -> float:
    17→    """台股最小跳動單位（依股價分級）"""
    18→    if price < 10:
    19→        return 0.01
    20→    elif price < 50:
    21→        return 0.05
    22→    elif price < 100:
    23→        return 0.10
    24→    elif price < 500:
    25→        return 0.50
    26→    elif price < 1000:
    27→        return 1.00
    28→    else:
    29→        return 5.00
    30→
    31→
    32→def _calc_bucket_size(min_price: float, max_price: float, target: int = 40) -> float:
    33→    """以 tick size 為單位計算 bucket 寬度，目標約 target 格"""
    34→    tick = _tick_size((min_price + max_price) / 2)
    35→    ticks_per_bucket = max(1, math.ceil((max_price - min_price) / target / tick))
    36→    return ticks_per_bucket * tick
    37→
    38→VALID_PERIODS = {"5d", "1mo", "3mo", "6mo", "1y"}
    39→
    40→
    41→@router.get("/search")
    42→def search(
    43→    q: str = Query(..., min_length=2),
    44→    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
    45→):
    46→    results = search_stocks(q, limit=10)
    47→    return results
    48→
    49→
    50→@router.get("/{ticker}/price")
    51→def get_price(ticker: str, _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):
    52→    try:
    53→        info = yf.Ticker(ticker).fast_info
    54→        price = info.last_price
    55→        prev_close = info.previous_close
    56→        change_percent = ((price - prev_close) / prev_close * 100) if prev_close else 0
    57→        return {
    58→            "ticker": ticker,
    59→            "price": round(price, 2),
    60→            "change_percent": round(change_percent, 2),
    61→        }
    62→    except Exception as e:
    63→        logger.error(f"Failed to fetch price for {ticker}: {e}")
    64→        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Failed to fetch stock price")
    65→
    66→
    67→@router.get("/{ticker}/chart")
    68→def get_chart(
    69→    ticker: str,
    70→    period: str = Query(default="3mo"),
    71→    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
    72→):
    73→    if period not in VALID_PERIODS:
    74→        raise HTTPException(
    75→            status_code=422,
    76→            detail=f"Invalid period. Must be one of: {', '.join(sorted(VALID_PERIODS))}",
    77→        )
    78→    try:
    79→        df = yf.Ticker(ticker).history(period=period)
    80→        if df.empty:
    81→            return []
    82→        records = []
    83→        for ts, row in df.iterrows():
    84→            records.append({
    85→                "time": ts.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
    86→                "open": round(float(row["Open"]), 2),
    87→                "high": round(float(row["High"]), 2),
    88→                "low": round(float(row["Low"]), 2),
    89→                "close": round(float(row["Close"]), 2),
    90→                "volume": int(row["Volume"]),
    91→            })
    92→        return records
    93→    except Exception as e:
    94→        logger.error(f"Failed to fetch chart for {ticker}: {e}")
    95→        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Failed to fetch chart data")
    96→
    97→
    98→@router.get("/{ticker}/volume-profile")
    99→def get_volume_profile(
   100→    ticker: str,
   101→    period: str = Query(default="3mo"),
   102→    _: str = Depends(get_current_user),
   103→):
   104→    if period not in VALID_PERIODS:
   105→        raise HTTPException(
   106→            status_code=422,
   107→            detail=f"Invalid period. Must be one of: {', '.join(sorted(VALID_PERIODS))}",
   108→        )
   109→    try:
   110→        tk = yf.Ticker(ticker)
   111→        df = tk.history(period=period)
   112→        if df.empty:
   113→            return []
   114→
   115→        current_price = tk.fast_info.last_price
   116→        min_price = float(df["Low"].min())
   117→        max_price = float(df["High"].max())
   118→        bucket_size = _calc_bucket_size(min_price, max_price)
   119→        num_buckets = math.ceil((max_price - min_price) / bucket_size)
   120→
   121→        volumes = [0.0] * num_buckets
   122→        for _, row in df.iterrows():
   123→            typical = (float(row["High"]) + float(row["Low"]) + float(row["Close"])) / 3
   124→            idx = int((typical - min_price) / bucket_size)
   125→            idx = min(idx, num_buckets - 1)
   126→            volumes[idx] += float(row["Volume"])
   127→
   128→        result = []
   129→        for i in range(num_buckets - 1, -1, -1):
   130→            low = round(min_price + i * bucket_size, 2)
   131→            high = round(min_price + (i + 1) * bucket_size, 2)
   132→            if low <= current_price < high:
   133→                bar_type = "價"
   134→            elif high <= current_price:
   135→                bar_type = "支撐"
   136→            else:
   137→                bar_type = "壓力"
   138→            result.append({
   139→                "label": f"{low:.2f}~{high:.2f}",
   140→                "price_low": low,
   141→                "price_high": high,
   142→                "volume": int(volumes[i]),
   143→                "type": bar_type,
   144→            })
   145→
   146→        return result
   147→    except Exception as e:
   148→        logger.error(f"Failed to fetch volume profile for {ticker}: {e}")
   149→        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Failed to fetch volume profile")
   150→

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import client from '@/api/client'

const query = ref('')
const inputEl = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null)
const suggestions = ref<{ ticker: string; code: string; name: string }[]>([])
const activeSuggestion = ref(-1)
const searching = ref(false)
const loading = ref(false)
const error = ref('')
const stockInfo = ref<any>(null)
const priceInfo = ref<any>(null)

let searchTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null

function onInput() {
  activeSuggestion.value = -1
  if (searchTimer) clearTimeout(searchTimer)
  const q = query.value.trim()
  if (q.length < 1) {
    suggestions.value = []
    return
  }
  searchTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
    if (q.length < 2) return
    searching.value = true
    try {
      const res = await client.get('/stocks/search', { params: { q } })
      suggestions.value = res.data
    } catch {
      suggestions.value = []
    } finally {
      searching.value = false
    }
  }, 300)
}

function moveSuggestion(dir: number) {
  const len = suggestions.value.length
  if (!len) return
  activeSuggestion.value = (activeSuggestion.value + dir + len) % len
}

async function selectSuggestion(idx: number) {
  const s = idx >= 0 ? suggestions.value[idx] : suggestions.value[0]
  if (!s) return
  suggestions.value = []
  query.value = `${s.code} ${s.name}`
  await loadStock(s.ticker)
}

async function loadStock(ticker: string) {
  loading.value = true
  error.value = ''
  stockInfo.value = null
  priceInfo.value = null
  try {
    const [infoRes, priceRes] = await Promise.all([
      client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/info`),
      client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/price`),
    ])
    stockInfo.value = infoRes.data
    priceInfo.value = priceRes.data
  } catch (e: any) {
    error.value = e?.response?.data?.detail ?? '載入失敗，請稍後再試'
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

function formatMarketCap(val: number): string {
  if (val >= 1e12) return (val / 1e12).toFixed(2) + ' 兆'
  if (val >= 1e8) return (val / 1e8).toFixed(2) + ' 億'
  if (val >= 1e4) return (val / 1e4).toFixed(2) + ' 萬'
  return val.toLocaleString()
}
</script>

The user wants to add a "股票當沖" (day trading) option for the stock type. Let me explain what I know about 股票當沖 in Taiwan.

台灣股票當沖（Day Trading）的計算方式：

當沖是指在同一天內買進再賣出（或先賣後買）同一檔股票。

**費用計算：**
- 手續費：買進 + 賣出各收一次，一樣是 0.1425%（最低20元）
- 交易稅：當沖的證券交易稅是 0.15%，相比一般股票的 0.3% 優惠減半。這個優惠稅率原本到2024年底，但已延長至我的知識截止日期。

**計算公式（當沖）：**
- 買入手續費 = max(20, round(買入價 × 股數 × 0.1425%))
</details></think>
